episode_title: A Patent, A Bezel, And The Leap Into Independence with Mount West Watch Co.

real_qa.q: What is the proprietary bezel system that Mount West Watch Co. features in The Summit collection?
real_qa.r: Drew brought a proprietary dual unidirectional bezel system that sets the brand apart from the increasingly crowded watch market. He conceived of a design featuring two rotating bezels that operate together, which he had not seen done that way before in existing watches.
real_qa.requete: Mount West Watch Co dual unidirectional bezel

real_qa.q: Why did Drew decide to start Mount West Watch Co. instead of licensing his bezel design?
real_qa.r: Drew initially thought about licensing the bezel to someone else as probably an easier path to success. However, after doing research, he found the process overwhelming and daunting without industry experience. He realized that protecting the invention would cost tens of thousands of dollars anyway, so starting his own company made sense to maintain creative control over the complete watch design.
real_qa.requete: why did Drew start Mount West Watch instead of licensing

real_qa.q: What is the angular case design philosophy behind Mount West Watch's Summit collection?
real_qa.r: Drew designed the Summit case with a flat edge rail on the back where most watches continue the circle. He cut that section to create an overhang to prevent the watch from catching on pants while providing maximum traction. He pushed the angular case design further, which eventually resembled a mountain and canyon shape reflecting Utah's jagged landscapes.
real_qa.requete: Mount West Summit watch case design flat rail

real_qa.q: How did Drew approach the challenge of bringing an innovative bezel concept to market as an independent brand founder?
real_qa.r: Drew emphasized that nothing moves quickly in watch manufacturing—it is not a three-month process from idea to ready product. The initial starting point was to make a case to fit the proprietary bezel design, which then necessitated making end links, a bracelet, and ensuring aesthetic uniqueness. He wanted to build something completely unique rather than compromise the vision.
real_qa.requete: independent watch brand challenges launch timeline

real_qa.q: What drove Drew's decision to launch an independent watch brand despite personal risk?
real_qa.r: Drew felt compelled to bring his vision into the world because when you have a vision you conceive as the only pathway forward, you are driven to pursue it. The fear of regret down the line, combined with his passion for hobbies like being outdoors and family, made shooting for the stars the only option—otherwise he would regret it.
real_qa.requete: why start independent watch brand founder motivation

guest.bio_context: Drew is a watch enthusiast who has been collecting for a long time. He grew up in Utah in a ski resort environment due to his father's 50-year career there, which shaped his connection to the rugged landscapes of the American West. Before launching Mount West Watch Co., he attempted other ventures but found watch design to be the most promising, fulfilling, and engaging project.

real_quote: When you have a vision that you see as the only pathway forward, you're compelled to do it—maybe the fear of regret down the line.
